contentText:
This image shows which Apple devices are included in its new leasing program. | Image: Apple

Apple has officially introduced " Apple Upgrade ," a new leasing program that aims to make it easier to get your hands on the latest iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Apple Watch models. The service is launching today in the US, and works like a car lease - allowing users to keep a device at the end of their subscription period, pay off the device early, or upgrade early to a new model.
